gates.acceptance: Versioned schema and identical golden vectors pass on Main Platform and CloudOS.
Ed25519 signing/verification is fail-closed; tampering is rejected; customer artifacts contain no private signing key.
30-day trial lifecycle is enforced and trial reset/reuse is rejected.
Activation, renewal, deactivation/transfer and retry idempotency are verified.
Entitlements are server-bound and cloned/mismatched server identities are rejected.
Plans, features and limits are enforced at privileged service boundaries.
Signed offline lease/cache/grace works; restricted mode preserves recovery/export and existing customer data.
License revocation/reactivation plus signing-key rotation/revocation are verified.
Tenant and RBAC isolation prevents cross-tenant licensing/control actions.
Release/update signatures use a separate trust domain; tampered/wrong-scope updates fail and rollback policy is verified.
No license/release/evidence private signing key is present in repos, dumps, frontend or CloudOS customer artifacts.
Real Main Platform to real CloudOS lifecycle passes on the exact commits and contract hash.
